kv.memory.git-vouch-metarule-2-mark-2026: git-vouch METARULE 2 (Mark 2026-10-22): we are unix heads - keep adding small tools that do just one thing (git-vouch, git-vouch-migrate, git-vouch-attest, git-vouch-trqp...) rather than growing git-vouch.
kv.memory.git-vouch-metarule-mark-2026-1: git-vouch METARULE (Mark 2026-10-22): don't replace anything git already does; the registry db always lives in git. git-vouch may and should read git history (commit order, dates, deletions) instead of inventing records (no tombstones, no sequence numbers, no snapshot-only workarounds).
kv.memory.git-vouch-migration-decided-by: git-vouch migration decided by Mark 2026-10-22: git-vouch (SSH signing + registry) completely replaces the gpg binary and the gpg keyring for the kernel. Flag day: port the gpg db (pgpkeys.git) into registry format, everyone re-signs with SSH keys. No OpenPGP signing, no dual-tag transition. (An earlier note saying 'pivot to OpenPGP' was a misunderstanding and was deleted.)
